label: Produced because of its goodness: end-content, controlled goodness dependence, apprehended plan
resolution: 'The source produces this arrangement because of its goodness' has three typed readings, each distinct from producing an arrangement that is in fact beneficial (the good-favouring table's D-nature row: it favours the better c over z without depending on goodness). BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_1 (BecauseOfContent): the favouring depends on realization of the end D, so the end content specifies the orientation; a D-directed noncognitive nature meets it and a physical proxy fails it at a recipient-relative reversal. BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2 (BecauseOfGoodness): the favouring depends on betterness with D-realization held fixed; it separates good-general from determined-to-one profiles, whatever the bearer, and needs scenarios that vary goodness at fixed D-realization (counterpossible if goodness is necessary; without them no aligned profile meets it). BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_3 (PracticalSpecification.Governing): an apprehended plan actually governs the giving; readings 1 and 2 do not supply its apprehension or its primitive SpecifiesGiving. Reading 1 does not entail reading 2 (the D-nature row); the converse is not tested here; neither 1 nor 2 supplies 3. No step passes between them: the good-favouring table states readings 1 and 2 separately for the same profiles, and nothing in this batch uses reading 3 beyond its definition.
